verdict.rationale: Luma's docs show you can get API keys and create multiple named keys (e.g. 'production', 'staging') that share quota. Nothing in the evidence shows keys can be limited by permission, endpoint, or resource, so least-privilege scoping is undocumented. Named keys are an adjacent feature, not scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
